Usage: zealakit discovery [options] [command]

Local Project Discovery feedback and stateless JSON queries (offline; no network
uploads)

Options:
  -h, --help         display help for command

Commands:
  query [options]    Run a stateless Discovery JSON operation (questions |
                     recommendations | validate | scaffold); reads a request
                     from stdin or --input
  stats              Show aggregated local Discovery feedback statistics
  feedback [action]  Enable, disable, clear, or show local Discovery feedback
                     settings
  help [command]     display help for command
